info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Operation E Create Enterprise Architectures-spec
info.description: The Enterprise Architecture Listing API allows users to access and retrieve a comprehensive list of enterprise architecture configurations relevant to business direction. This endpoint serves as a resource for business analysts and architects seeking to understand and evaluate existing architectural operations categorized under 'e-create-enterprise-architecture.' By providing insight into various configurations, this API aids in informed decision-making and strategic planning within the banking sector, fostering effective alignment between technology and business objectives.

get.summary: Create a new enterprise architecture for a specified business direction.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new enterprise architecture tailored to a specific business direction identified by the resource ID. It provides a streamlined way to manage enterprise architecture setups to align with business strategies.
